news.headline: What to Expect From UniQure's Upcoming Huntington's Gene Therapy Readout
news.summary: STAT previewed the closely-watched four-year AMT-130 data due before the end of Q3 2026, noting the readout will be scrutinized by FDA reviewers and could shape the pending BLA review and any advisory committee.

news.headline: AdCom Expected for uniQure's Huntington's Gene Therapy, Chief Medical Officer Says
news.summary: uniQure CMO Walid Abi-Saab said the company expects, welcomes, and is preparing for an FDA advisory committee meeting on AMT-130 ahead of a potential approval decision.

news.headline: uniQure Filed for Huntington's Approval. Acceptance Is the Catalyst, Analyst Says
news.summary: William Blair resumed coverage of uniQure with an Outperform rating and a $73 fair-value estimate, framing FDA acceptance of the BLA as the next near-term catalyst toward a possible first-half-2027 approval.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Submission of Biologics License Application for Ifezuntirgene Inilparvovec (AMT-130) in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure submitted a BLA to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 with a priority review request, and simultaneously filed a Marketing Authorisation Application with the UK MHRA, both built on the previously reported three-year Phase I/II data (75% slowing of disease progression at the high dose vs. external control).

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reaffirmed plans for Q3 2026 BLA/MAA filings and a September four-year AMT-130 data readout, reporting cash and investments of $810.3 million (runway into 2030) after closing an upsized $259 million public offering.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II topline data (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided readout covering four-year follow-up in 12 high-dose and 12 low-dose patients (plus additional high-dose patients at three years) vs. an external natural-history control; as of September 19-20, 2026 this data had not yet been released.

catalysts.label: FDA BLA filing acceptance & priority review decision
catalysts.detail: The FDA's standard 60-day filing review following the September 2, 2026 BLA submission should determine whether the application is accepted and whether the requested priority review (6-month clock) is granted.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA MAA review outcome
catalysts.detail: Parallel Marketing Authorisation Application submitted September 2, 2026 for AMT-130; MHRA acceptance and review timeline not yet confirmed.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly update expected to give fresh commentary on regulatory timeline, market reaction to the four-year data, and cash position.

catalysts.label: FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: CMO Walid Abi-Saab said uniQure expects and is preparing for an AdCom on AMT-130 as part of the BLA review process.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA action date / approval decision for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If priority review is granted, a 6-month review clock following the 60-day filing period would point to an action date around Q2 2027, which could make AMT-130 the first approved disease-modifying therapy for Huntington's disease.

pulse: uniQure filed a BLA with the FDA (Sept 2, 2026) seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 for Huntington's disease with a priority review request, alongside a parallel UK MHRA MAA submission, both built on the previously reported three-year data (75% slowing of disease progression at the high dose). The keenly-awaited four-year topline readout, guided for 'before end of September,' had not yet been released as of Sept 20, while FDA filing acceptance/priority-review decision is expected around early November 2026 and an advisory committee is anticipated before any approval. Wall Street sentiment has turned more constructive since the filing (e.g., William Blair initiated at Outperform, $73 fair value), and cash runway extends into 2030 after a $259 million raise, but the stock remains a binary-catalyst story pending the outstanding data and regulatory milestones.
